# RM brief — PURE COLLECTION CASHMERE LIMITED (12591963)
*as of 2026-09-30 · research passes: 1*

**Decision: REFER** — set by CON-06 — Stale financial information; SEC-01 — Outstanding third-party charge; SEC-06 — Multiple simultaneous charges to one lender; SEC-07 — Negative pledge; SEC-08 — Floating charge over the whole undertaking  
**Qualifies as a lead:** yes

## Summary

- Pure Collection Cashmere Limited (company number 12591963) is an active private limited company incorporated on 7 May 2020, filing small-company accounts under SIC code 47910. It has three active officers out of four ever appointed, with no new appointments in the last 12 months. `[profile; officers]`
- One charge is outstanding: charge 125919630005, created 15 April 2025 in favour of Barclays Bank PLC, a third-party lender outside the group. Under SEC-01 no first-charge facility can be offered, and any new facility would rank as a second charge unless that charge is redeemed at completion. `[125919630005; SEC-01]`
- That outstanding Barclays charge includes a floating charge as well as a fixed charge, so under SEC-08 the case must be referred to assess what unencumbered assets remain. `[125919630005; SEC-08]`
- Four earlier charges (125919630001 to 125919630004) were all created on 11 December 2023 in favour of Lloyds Bank PLC and Lloyds Bank Corporate Markets PLC and are all recorded as fully satisfied; SEC-03 disregards them for ranking, but SEC-06 treats the same-day pairs to each lender as a structured or tranched facility and requires full redemption figures for all charges before any refinance is quoted. `[125919630001; 125919630002; 125919630003; 125919630004; SEC-03; SEC-06]`
- Every charge on record, including the outstanding Barclays charge, contains a negative pledge. Under SEC-07, written consent from the existing lender must be evidenced before any facility is offered. `[125919630005; 125919630004; 125919630003; 125919630002; 125919630001; SEC-07]`
- Filing conduct is consistently good: the last five sets of accounts, from December 2021 through November 2025, were all filed ahead of their due dates, and no accounts are currently overdue (next due 31 December 2026). `[AA filed 2025-11-05; AA filed 2024-12-11; AA filed 2023-12-18; AA filed 2022-12-19; AA filed 2021-12-01; profile]`
- Despite the clean filing record, the latest accounts are made up to 29 March 2025 — 18.1 months before the 30 September 2026 assessment date — so under CON-06 the financial position on record is no longer current and up-to-date figures should be requested. `[computed; CON-06; profile]`
